methods_quotes.q: HIV/AIDS data were adjusted for delays in reporting of cases and deaths.
Estimates for the mode of exposure were adjusted for anticipated reclassification of cases reported originally without this information
Data with or without AIDS were analyzed by the earliest date of diagnosis of HIV for 1994--2000.
